_note: Synthetic fixture. Calendar bodies are invented; injections sit inside calendar_text as they would in a real invite. `expected` is the ANSWER KEY used by the tests and the results generator - the pipelines never read it. Provenance is DERIVED from structured fields (organizer / forward chain), never from text or labels. No network, no credentials, no real mailboxes.

downstream_policy.note: High-risk untrusted attempts are always blocked; low-risk untrusted attempts are blocked only when the detector is suspicious; trusted attempts are blocked only when suspicious. No attempt means not_requested.
